reason: $59 a month is a lot when library storytime and the parks are free, and I can organize a playdate at someone's house for nothing. It looks pretty, but I would not commit to a membership for a place that has not opened yet.
objection: Paying $59 a month for something I have not seen, when free options already fill most of our week. A membership only makes sense if we would go several times a week, and I doubt we would.
would_change_my_mind: A free or cheap trial visit, or a drop-in price closer to $8 to $10 that I could try once. If my moms group got a group rate or a free first visit, I would bring everyone.
